verdict.rationale: Khoj's docs describe voice chat: you talk to it by voice on the web, Desktop and Obsidian apps, and a speaker icon next to any message reads replies aloud. The GitHub README separately confirms 'talk out loud, play your messages'. Both voice input and spoken replies are therefore first-party capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of live, continuous voice conversation, details of the transcription pipeline (e.g. voice notes on WhatsApp), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can interact by voice — voice notes get transcribed, replies can be spoken, or live voice conversations are supported

citations.quote: You can talk to Khoj using your voice. Khoj will respond to your queries using the same models as the chat feature.
You can also click on the speaker icon next to any message to hear it out loud.
You can use voice chat on the web, Desktop, and Obsidian apps.
Generate images, talk out loud, play your messages.
